23142.overview:
FarmVille is a farming simulation social network game developed by Zynga in 2009. It is similar to Happy Farm, Farm Town, and video games such as the Story of Seasons series. Its gameplay involves various aspects of farm management such as plowing land, planting, growing, and harvesting crops, harvesting trees and raising livestock.

A sequel, FarmVille 2, was released in September 2012.

FarmVille is available as an Adobe Flash application via the social-networking website Facebook and Microsoft's MSN Games,and was available as an application ("app") for the iPhone, iPod Touch and iPad for a brief period in 2010. The game is free to play; however, to progress quickly within the game, players are encouraged to spend Farm Cash (in FarmVille) or Farm Bucks (in FarmVille 2), which are purchasable with real-world currency, or to "get help from their friends".

After its launch on Facebook in 2009, FarmVille became the most popular game on the site, and held that position for over two years. Starting after 2011, the game began experiencing a considerable decline in popularity. By May 2012, the game was ranked as the seventh most popular Facebook game. As of July 12, 2014, its rank had fallen to the seventy-third most popular Facebook game by Daily Active Users.

118386.overview: Fancy Pants Adventures is a series of free side-scrolling Flash games created by Brad Borne. Three worlds have been released so far. World 1 was released on March 14, 2006 and World 2 was released on January 9, 2008. After the 2009 Comic-Con, Borne announced he would officially start working on World 3. It was released on April 5, 2012. A console version developed by Borne and Over the Top Games was released by EA 2D for PlayStation Network and Xbox Live Arcade on April 19 and April 20, 2011, respectively. An iOS version developed by Chillingo, Over the Top Games and Borne Games was released on the Apple App Store on March 4, 2012.

118387.overview:
Flash Element TD is a Flash-based tower defense browser game created by David Scott and launched in January 2007. The game had been played over 140 million times as of March 2009.

David Scott got the inspiration for Flash Element TD in 2006. He noticed that no one had created a Tower Defense game using Flash and only started work on Flash Element TD as a technical exercise to see if it was possible. The map and name is based on the "Element TD" map created for the real-time strategy game Warcraft III by Brian Powers and Evan Hatampour, David Scott created a much simpler version of the map that could be played using only a browser. The game was launched in January 2007 and still has growth to this day.

118388.overview: Frog Fractions is a 2012 browser game developed by Twinbeard Studios, a company composed primarily of founder Jim Crawford. The game, released on October 25, 2012, has been described as a spoof of the edutainment game genre. In the game, the player begins by controlling a frog to eat bugs and defend fruit. Later on, the player may spend points on upgrades to improve their frog's abilities. The game does not actually teach the player about fractions; the player's score is given in fractions, but no knowledge of them is necessary to play.

151865.overview:
Catch me if you can! Do you have what it takes to tackle the Free Run obstacle course?
In this game, you must be interested in free run. There are a lot of barriers you can meet. What you should do will be point out. Do this. React to key prompts and don’t stop running! You need to Faster your time and try to get the higher score. Free run means you must keep running. So, if you stop or do the wrong actions, unfortunately you’d better replay this game. When this game point out what you should do next, you must do it right now, not do it in front of the barriers. You can practice your competence through this game. Free run must be a game you shouldn’t miss.

165544.overview:
Fleeing the complex is one in the genre of the strategy games. After exciting Henry Stickmin’s adventures game series has made great success, Fleeing the complex game is now coming back to make it shoot with amazing features and new exciting challenges.

Right from the start, players will be brought to a distant land by the trailer in the beginning of the game. There are mountains which are fully covered by snow and a small prison in that land. In the prison, the prisoners are very infamous but intelligent criminals from all over the world. Henry is one of the criminals who just have been imprisoned there.

In the game, you are in an adventure with Henry and you have to help Henry Stickmin to escape from the prison by your wonderful plans and strategies. Therefore, Henry Stickmin can break the bank and escape from the prison as soon as possible.

167855.overview:
FacePunch.io is an io boxing arena game where you must fight to be the champion. Check out the new smash hit io game: Facepunch.io Boxing Arena! Step onto the ring to knock out all champions with your brutal punches and devastating combos!

Can you become the champion fighter of the boxing arena?

177918.overview:
Fireboy and Watergirl need help to explore the Forest Temple. Solve the puzzles, beat the times and collect all the diamonds!


Play alone or with a friend to join Fireboy and Watergirl in this adventure!


Turn levers and push buttons to complete these 32 levels of the official Fireboy and Watergirl series.

215126.overview:
This official demake was released by Bethesda as a marketing tool leading up to the release of Fallout New Vegas.

"What would Fallout look like if it had been made in 1987 by a Japanese development studio? Our scientists have answered that question, taking over the Japanese Fallout website with an 8-bit version of the Capital Wasteland. Just like that import copy of Final Fantasy 5 you nabbed in the 90s, this game is Japanese language only. Fortunately, it’s still amusing to gaze at the pixelated approximations of super mutants and the like. Here’s a direct link right to the game; no cartridge-cleaning required." -Bethesda Blog

422910.overview: Fantastic Contraption is a 2D physics building and puzzle game. In every level the goal is to get a red ball from a blue building zone to a pink goal area. This is done by constructing contraptions using wood rods (solid), water rods (pass through stuff), and wheels that turn clockwise or counterclockwise to create contraptions that guide the ball to the goal zone. Players can create tanks, conveyor belts, catapults, slingshots, ramps, pulleys to achieve this. A lot of experimentation and trial and error with the physics is usually required to finish a level. The available tools are available near the top of the screen and there is no fixed solution.

422919.overview: You're a charity worker who goes around punching people who don't have safety alarms until they're scared enough to want personal safety alarms. For their safety.

422930.overview: Factory Balls is a simple puzzle game. It contains 14 levels in which the player needs to drag and drop a plain white ball over some provided tools, like a paint bucket, to produce the required ball. When a mistake has been made, the current ball can be thrown in the bin. Only 17 balls are available to finish all the levels however; it's game over otherwise.

422942.overview: Fleabag VS Mutt, often referred to as Cat VS Dog, is a Flash game by gametuner.com where a teal cat (Fleabag) and a gray dog (Mutt) throw objects at each other until one of them gets knocked down.

422943.overview: Play the role of a blood-thirsty foreign creature leaving a trail of blood and horror.

422945.overview: The player commands a pirate ship against a barrage of sharks and evil pirates and eventually big bosses. The ship's only weapon is cannon fire. As money is earned throughout the game, it can be spent on ship upgrades making faster and stronger cannons, able to carry more loot, draw loot to it and the speed the ship sails. The upgrades are flexible allowing the player to choose how they want to play the game.

422948.overview:
Four Second Fury is, like the WarioWare series, a collection of 20 microgames. Each game lasts four seconds, and some can be completed faster if the player reaches the specific goal before the time limit. If the player fails a game, they lose one of their five lives. The games appear in a random order and vary in style, including playing Pong, shaking cola cans, reaching certain points on the screen, pressing a key at the right moment, and avoiding enemies.

After completing the microgames, the player must defeat a boss enemy. After that, the required time can be entered into a high score list.

Four Second Fury is played using the keyboard, specifically, the arrow keys and the space bar.

422950.overview:
lOw is a PlayStation Network game, originally an online flash project by Jenova Chen and Nicholas Clark as a part of Chen's thesis research, but later adapted to a commercial game by thatgamecompany, which Chen co-founded.

The player controls a small, worm-like micro-organism on a bright, two-dimensional plane. On the PS3, it can be moved around by tilting the SIXAXIS controller in the direction the creature should swim. The PSP version is controlled with the analogue stick. There are six, gradually unlocked creatures to choose from (Snake, Jelly, Manta, Rogue, Hunter, Credit Creature), each with their own abilities such as poison, a swirling move to draw in plankton or a homing attack. The aim of the game is to eat other micro-organisms and evolve, moving deeper into the sea until the bottom is reached, leading the game to restart with a new creature. Evolving will change the creature's shape or grants new abilities. There are different power-ups, making the creature move faster or giving it a larger mouth. Certain larger enemies are made up of dots that need to be eaten to have it destroyed, requiring different strategies to take them out.

With each new level, moving deeper into the sea, the background, colours, enemies and music change. The creature is able to return to previous levels, or dive deeper, indicated by different icons. The game has straightforward controls and offers multiplayer sessions for up to 4 players, all using the same creature.

flOw applies the concept of dynamic difficulty adjustment. Players can choose to ignore large and dangerous enemies or come back to fight them later, striking a balance between the game's challenges and the individual abilities.

422952.overview: A game made in 48 hours for Ludum Dare #23

422953.overview: Flaming Zombooka is an arcade games developed by LongAnimals and RobotJam. It has 3 games in the series.

422960.overview: A girl's recurring nightmares of being chased by death. Clear your mind and fight back against the darkness!

422963.overview: Adult Swim: Stan is in hell. He lives the day-in, day-out workaday life of a cube jockey. A last-minute meeting request pushes him over the edge. As Stan, you wander the office space finding ingenious ways to hurt him until Stan's health is completely drained. He has but five minutes—if he can't do it by then, he's doomed to sit through yet another boring meeting. You're Stan's only hope.

422977.overview: Feudalism III is a role playing strategy flash game that was developed by VitalyZ and released on 2013.

422978.overview: Field Command is an action strategy Flash game. These is war games where the player has to battle to win.

422979.overview:
A girl writes a note to Santa Claus, asking for her mother to return for Christmas. This note is folded into the form of a paper airplane and then it's off to the North Pole, into the night air, through London, Paris, Egypt, Kenya, and Japan. Of course, it doesn't traverse all these disparate locales without some help; the player will be picking it up and throwing it rather a lot, by clicking on the plane, dragging it to its launch position, and then swiping it across the screen for takeoff. Initially the plane is quite unsuited for flying and won't travel far, but through money earned by intercepting stars and covering distance, numerous upgrades of various kinds can be purchased, including a boost of sorts when the space bar is pressed and minor keyboard steering corrections.

The little stars aren't the only thing the paper plane has to contend with: sharing its airspace there are also origami cranes (initially bonus multipliers) and shooting stars (which give a substantial velocity boost), along with air currents to help or hinder the plane in its attempt to cover enormous amounts of distance. Down near the ground, sporadic fixed fans might help a plane caught in the final throes of a would-be fatal stall, while halfway to heaven jet streams cause enormously disruptive turbulence. But regardless of the aid or obstacles, every attempt gets the player closer to being able to afford a new upgrade, and a few feet closer to each stage's overall distance goal. Between stages, the note is intercepted and humorously misinterpreted, but at every step of the way it is nonetheless passed along to a new set of air currents and eddies.

422981.overview:
Fly Guy is a graphic adventure Flash game developed, designed, and published by Trevor van Meter, an illustrator and graphic designer from Greenville, North Carolina. It was originally released in 2002, then in 2016, it was re-released on mobile platforms, and is now available for iOS and Android. The game was rebuilt in GameMaker by Tom Sennett.

In this game, the gameplay is minimal; the player controls an employed man with the arrow keys, letting him move left and right and fly up and down in any two-dimensional direction. Throughout the world of the game, the player can encounter many abstract and nonsensical things, such as a floating monk, a sumo wrestler, and a man tiling bricks to make the sky, revealing a starry backdrop behind them. There are no goals or loss states in the game.

422990.overview: Try to eat as much flesh as possible and upgrade your devoted army of blood thirsty piranhas! A silly game of skill and high scores.

451769.overview: Run! They are determinated to kill you! Avoid enemy vehicles, your only chance to survive is to escape from your chasers by finding the escape way. You have no weapons and a limited fuel reserve. Pick up the bonuses along the map to get extra fuel and get car repair.

459170.overview:
A strange substance called Fusion Matter has begun to infect the world, causing chaos and spawning dangerous creatures. Planet Fusion, led by the evil Lord Fuse, is attempting to conquer Earth by merging its alien world with ours. As the planet descends into crisis, characters from across Cartoon Network's universe unite to fight back. Heroes like Ben Tennyson, Dexter, and the Powerpuff Girls call on new recruits to help stop the invasion. One of those recruits is you.

FusionFall is a third-person, online action-adventure MMORPG that blends exploration, combat, and platforming. Players create a custom avatar and travel through a reimagined Cartoon Network world filled with stylized versions of familiar locations and characters. The game features real-time combat using melee and ranged weapons, with missions that involve defeating enemies, rescuing allies, and completing objectives across various zones.

Throughout the game, players collect "Nanos," miniature sidekick versions of Cartoon Network characters. Each Nano grants a unique ability, such as stunning enemies, healing the player, or boosting speed. These abilities can be swapped and upgraded as the player progresses.

Experience points are earned by completing missions and defeating enemies, allowing the player to level up and unlock new equipment and areas. The game world is semi-open, with fast travel and public zones connecting story-driven regions. PvE is the primary focus, though social elements like teaming up and chatting are also included.

Originally launched in 2009, FusionFall was notable for its hybrid art style and cross-franchise integration. The official servers were shut down in 2013, but it remains a standout entry in the history of licensed online games.

472118.overview:
The game is an RPG/strategy. There’re no missions – only open world. You’re free to go anywhere and fight anyone, but the final goal is only one – capture all towns. Recruit troops at towns you control, buy better equipment, learn powerful skills and become the most powerful warrior and ruler of the whole world.
The world is bigger now, there’re 6 different nations,12 heroes, more new weapons and armor. Enemies do not drop magical items anymore, but they drop runes which can be combined with weapons giving them special effects.

480254.overview:
The First Cub is a 2D platformer with a great storytelling focus and varied gameplay that tries to push the limits of the Pico-8 engine.

The First is a member of an alien race called the "Bipterra", who was exiled from his tribe and rescued by a pair of scientists to test on him. Their motives seem unknown, whats only certain for The First is that they can't waste this chance.

Find out the truth behind the Bipterra and the E.G.

482488.overview: An independently developed Flash puzzle platformer in which fire and water characters work together to explore a forest temple. Move both heroes through obstacle rooms, operate mechanisms and use their different elemental resistances to reach the exits. This Forest Temple III game was made by Fei Cheng, Zero and Ning Tieying.

482496.overview: A cooperative puzzle platformer starring Fireboy and Watergirl in the Crystal Temple. Their different elemental abilities must be combined to operate switches, cross hazards and use crystal teleporters to reach the exits.

482503.overview: A cooperative puzzle platformer starring Fireboy and Watergirl in the Light Temple. Alongside their different abilities, mirrors and light beams must be used to open routes and reach the exits.

482504.overview: A cooperative puzzle platformer starring Fireboy and Watergirl in the Ice Temple. Slippery surfaces and mechanisms affected by their different elements require careful movement, planning and teamwork.
